items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I met Louie here in LA to work with him in a picture called 'New Orleans'. They were looking for guys from New Orleans and they got Zutty, Kid Ory, Bud Scott, -- Red Callender and Beal, [Charlie D.] [Eddie] Beal. We got together.

ctx.x: -- Red Callender and Beal, [Charlie D.] [Eddie] Beal.
We got together. Then Glaser wanted to try out something, so he booked Louis in --
